summary: RedHill Biopharma filed a routine Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements for the period ended June 30, 2026, covering normal-course items such as a Ferring license and commercial supply agreement, warrants issued with a June 2026 financing, and the sale of an interest in a joint venture with Talicia Holdings. No special-situation transaction—merger, tender, going-private, activist campaign, or strategic review—is disclosed as the event. The filing is an ordinary periodic report by a foreign private issuer, with no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle to assess.
